justifications.r1: Rakdos goblin mana dorks (Skirk Prospector) and cheap rocks.
justifications.r2: Goblin death draw and impulse card advantage.
justifications.a1: Goblin typal tutors (Goblin Matron, Boggart Harbinger).
justifications.p2: 2 opponent untap steps to eliminate players.
justifications.i1: Targeted burn and creature sacrifice removal.
justifications.s1: Standard goblin protection and haste enablers.
justifications.s2: Rebuilding requires fresh hand of goblins.
justifications.s3: Functions as a general goblin typal swarm without commander.
